title: Zainab ke khule sar pe hay khaak padi hai
body:
Zainab ke khule sar pe hay khaak padi hai
roti hui shabbir ke..(2) laashe pe khadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghabrai hui shimr ke tango se hai zainab
kehti thi aur shame..(2) ghareeba ki dari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Fizza ne ye roke kaha sajjad se jakar
zainab sare uryaan hai..(2) aur bheed badi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zainab gai darbar me islam ki khatir
darbaro me bazaro me..(2) hai jung ladi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Akhtar jo ghume saniye zahra me hai rota
wo roze jaza naare..(2) jahannum se bari hai
Haye zainab haye bazaar..(2)
